title: FlexCore — control-plane-api golden signals
description: P11.09 dashboard-as-code (Phase 11 wave 1, Agent B). Golden signals for the control-plane-api service [S-61]. Every panel queries a metric family defined in the P11.01 taxonomy record (records/01_p11_01_metric_taxonomy.md) or the pre-existing P1.20/P2.21 registry families — no panel invents a metric. WRITTEN-UNRUN: rendered against no live store; the live rendering check is a human gate input.

panels.title: Latency — p95 request duration (flexcore_api_request_duration_milliseconds)
panels.description: p95 over the P11.01 histogram (fixed registered bucket set; no route label by recorded cardinality decision).

panels.title: Errors — error ratio (flexcore_http_errors_total)
panels.description: The API error SLI shape from the P11.01 record §4; the SLO target on this ratio is a RECOMMENDATION pending operator sign-off (P11.02).

panels.title: Saturation — in-flight requests (flexcore_api_in_flight_requests)
panels.description: No labels by recorded cardinality decision; database-pool and broker saturation are NOT exposed by this family (the P11.01 record's known gap — not faked).

panels.title: Latency — good-event ratio at the registered 1000 ms bucket
panels.description: The latency-SLI numerator shape the P11.01 record §4 names for the burn-rate rules (le="1000" is the registered good-event threshold candidate, RECOMMENDATION).
